rules.text: Year to date paystub dated within 30 days of the application and W2s for 2024 and 2025.
Verbal verification of employment within 10 business days prior to the note date.
Signed 1040 with all schedules for 2024 and 2025.
rules.cite: cites the return pages p.47, p.52

rules.text: Year to date profit and loss statement for the business.
Verification of the existence of the business within 120 calendar days prior to the note date, by third party listing or CPA letter.
Schedule E for 2024 and 2025 with the current lease for each property.
Reserves after closing verified on the statement, as HUD Handbook 4000.1 asks when rental income qualifies the file.
Written verification of employment showing overtime, bonus and commission by year for 2024 and 2025 and year to date.
Large deposit letter of explanation with the source page.
Resolve open finding line 4 against the file page.
FHA case number assigned and printed in the file.
Certificate of Eligibility in the file.
Package routes only to an underwriter of record with a DE or SAR designation. Enter one on the account page.

500to2000.sentence: At {volume} files a month, the 500 File Pack covers a month with your condition library loaded for you and a variance report at the end of it.

above2000.sentence: At {volume} files a month you are past the volume the Enterprise Block is priced for, with your credit policy encoded and the documentation pack your governance inventory asks for.
